scope: Only the public evaluation festival HTML was modified. The original temporary draft, skill files, other cases, global tests and handoffs were not edited. No publication performed.

repairs.change: Shared content-sized schedule columns use CSS subgrid so enlarged time labels and header labels determine real track widths; artist/set/room text can reflow. No new DOM wrappers.
Header groups wrap within the viewport. The native day-pass dialog has an explicit viewport max width and a shrinkable title column beside a content-sized Close control. Price caption stays together.
Mobile wave artwork occupies the row after the actual wordmark height instead of a clamp-derived title offset. The original SVG is unchanged.
Dialog title is Day pass. The ornamental frequency caption is replaced by the actual filtered result count, including saved/room context.

actualVerification.browser: Playwright Chromium, local file URL, device scale factor 1
actualVerification.coreFlows: At each normal viewport: all room filters and All reset; exact factual result captions; save and unsave each of six events; real saved count; reload persistence; My programme; empty programme recovery; combined saved/room empty state and reset; native day-pass facts, unavailable checkout, Close, Escape and restored focus.
actualVerification.doubledTextChecks: Computed font sizes doubled from a snapshot in the transient browser DOM. Checked all six time/artist pairs, artist/set/room relationships, Save containment, header day-pass containment and page overflow. At 390px also checked wordmark/art clearance, dialog Close containment, horizontal overflow, reachable demo notice through vertical dialog scrolling, and Escape.
actualVerification.manualRenderInspection: Inspected actual normal desktop/mobile home, programme, empty and dialog captures, plus exact enlarged 900px header/schedule and 390px hero/dialog/notice captures.

limits: Chromium only; other browsers, physical devices and screen readers were not exercised.
Doubled computed-font stress is not actual browser zoom or a full accessibility audit.
The shared-column layout uses CSS subgrid, supported in the tested browser; older engines without subgrid were not tested.
The enlarged dialog intentionally scrolls vertically; its demo notice was reached and inspected.
No live checkout, payment, publication or external integration was tested or added.
publicationNote: Substantive observations retained; local paths normalized. Audit findings concern the preserved pre-repair snapshot; repair verification concerns the corrected example.
